description: Explicit scope gate preventing KAPIF from treating project directories as institutional knowledge.
repository_boundary_note: 11vated-growth_OS/ and Frontend-Designs/ remain project directories within the Foundry repo. They must not become institutional knowledge merely because they reside under the repository root. Repository boundary cleanup is still desirable but not within this milestone scope.

scope_classes.FOUNDRY_CANONICAL_SOURCE: Core Foundry source code and configuration
scope_classes.FOUNDRY_EVIDENCE: Calibration evidence, validation artifacts, benchmark results
scope_classes.FOUNDRY_FIXTURE: Tool distributions, backups, disposable test fixtures
scope_classes.PROJECT_SOURCE: 11vatedTech product source code — excluded from KAPIF ingestion
scope_classes.REQUIRES_REVIEW: Unknown content requiring human review before ingestion
